name: Patient settings Configuration Suites switch modules cleanly
description: In patient settings, clicking between Profile, Health ID & ABHA, Emergency Contacts & SOS, and Notifications activates each module.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the patient settings page at /patient/settings
Click the 'Profile' module in the Configuration Suites list
Verify the right panel displays the patient profile details with Full Legal Name and Mobile Number
Click the 'Emergency Contacts & SOS' module in the Configuration Suites list
Verify the emergency contacts management panel is displayed
